label: Invalid bundle rejected with an OperationOutcome
description: The service refuses the bundle as not valid and answers HTTP 400 with an OperationOutcome that names the element at fault, which PAS 2.0.1 allows in place of a bundle. The CRD sentinel P32H-BAD400 selects it too.
basis: Synthetic, in the shape PAS 2.0.1 gives a response (input/fsh and the examples of the guide's 2.0.1 source): the claim identifier echoed in ClaimResponse.identifier, the request named by reference, each decision in a review action on item.adjudication with its authorization number and the item's itemPreAuthPeriod, and an item trace number on each item. Every value the guide leaves open is a placeholder of this project. It has not been observed from the live service.

details.text: The bundle is not a valid prior authorization request.

issue.diagnostics: Claim.insurance: at least one is required, and none was found.
